## Why

A vocabulary migration needs a guard or later prompts and docs can silently reintroduce the deprecated heading. This story removes the final live prose uses and adds a repository guard while preserving frozen migration evidence, Jira captures, and the four permanent semantic carve-outs owned by the epic.

## Scope

- Add scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py.
- Add the plain-text allowlist scripts/criteria-vocabulary-allowlist.txt. Each non-comment row is tab-delimited as path<TAB>integer-count<TAB>reason; lines beginning with # are comments. Missing fields, a non-integer or non-positive count, duplicate paths, absent paths, and count mismatch in either direction are malformed or stale. The guard fails when actual count is lower or higher than pinned, so exemptions cannot remain vacuous or silently accumulate vocabulary. Example: docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md<TAB>1<TAB>generated T2 experiment-language echo.
- Wire the guard directly into the root Makefile lint target so local make lint and CI run the same check.
- Match Success Criteria, success criteria, and success criterion case-insensitively across the repository, excluding only docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, the minified vendor bundle src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/dist/editor.js, and ordinary tool/cache/VCS directories.
- Match bare SC or SCs only under src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md. Bare tokens elsewhere are outside this rule by design; O-RAN-SC therefore needs no regex exemption.
- Migrate the residual live prose in src/rebar/llm/completion.py and the matching test explanation in tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py from success criteria to acceptance criteria.
- Migrate docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl from the deprecated Success Criteria heading so the live sample teaches only Acceptance Criteria.

## Exact-phrase inventory and disposition

The following matches are deliberate and must be represented by non-vacuous rows in scripts/criteria-vocabulary-allowlist.txt with their current exact counts:

- docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md: generated echo of the T2 experiment wording, exactly one match.
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T2.md: permanent experiment-language carve-out, exactly one match.
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md, src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, and src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify_models.py: permanent definition-of-done / success criterion concept, exactly one match each.
- scripts/migrate_success_criteria.py plus tests/scripts/test_migrate_success_criteria.py and tests/scripts/test_migrate_success_criteria_heldout.py: the one-time migration and its positive/edge probes must name the legacy heading they transform.
- tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_criteria_heading_collapse.py, tests/unit/test_eval_solver.py, and tests/unit/test_eval_solver_criteria_heading_heldout.py: negative-case behavioral probes proving the legacy heading is inert or removed.
- tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py and tests/unit/test_registry_version_rotation.py: regression tests that inspect the permanent carve-outs and registry-version migration.
- tests/fixtures/jira/search.json: captured Jira payload containing ## Success Criteria.
- tests/fixtures/jira/comment_map.json: captured Jira comment containing historical Parent SC wording and an acceptance/success criterion phrase.
- tests/interfaces/store/test_canonical_event_bytes.py and tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py: historical criterion citations, exactly one match each.

The following are migrated rather than allowlisted: src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl.

The following are excluded by scan scope rather than allowlisted: docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, the minified editor.js vendor bundle, and ordinary generated/cache/VCS directories.

No exemption is created for tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_reduce_all.py:120. Its bare SC token is outside the deliberately narrow bare-token path scope. Likewise, bare SC in tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py is a negative control outside the scoped production paths, not an allowlist entry.

The four O-RAN-SC sites in docs/adr/0021-replication-change-refs.md, docs/adr/0022-g2p-in-container.md, docs/adr/0023-inbound-github-gerrit-ssh-vote.md, and .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml are outside the bare-token path scope and are checked for byte stability against the pinned pre-migration base.

## Approach

1. Run python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide before implementation. It must be a no-op on current main and docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must retain the T2 section with exactly one allowed phrase match.
2. Add RED-first unit tests for the guard parser and scanner, plus an end-to-end test that invokes the root make lint target.
3. Implement the guard as a deterministic repository-rooted scanner using the plain-text count-pinned allowlist. Diagnostics identify path, line, and matched vocabulary. The command returns non-zero for unallowlisted matches, count drift, malformed/duplicate entries, and stale entries.
4. Make the three live-prose migrations listed above and populate only the deliberate inventory rows.
5. Run the guard, make lint, make typecheck, and the full pytest suite.

## Testing

- Happy path: the current migrated checkout passes with every deliberate phrase accounted for at its pinned count.
- Positive phrase case: injecting ## Success Criteria into a normal live source path fails and identifies the injected path.
- Positive bare-token case: injecting bare SC into a scoped reviewer, guide, routing, or generated-guide path fails.
- Negative path-scope control: injecting bare SC outside those scoped paths does not fail.
- Allowlist integrity: malformed fields, duplicate paths, absent paths, count increases, and count decreases fail deterministically.
- Frozen-record controls: the two Jira fixtures remain accepted for their documented captured text; lifecycle and migration probes remain accepted only at their pinned counts.
- O-RAN control: all four O-RAN-SC sites remain byte-identical to commit a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c and do not trigger the bare-token rule.
- End to end: a temporary live-source injection makes the root make lint target fail through the new guard, while the clean checkout passes.
- Regenerate the criteria guide and confirm T2 plus exactly one generated carve-out match before guard validation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py and scripts/criteria-vocabulary-allowlist.txt enforce the exact-phrase and scoped bare-token policies with count-pinned, non-vacuous exemptions.
- [ ] The root Makefile lint target runs the guard, and a live-source injection proves lint exits non-zero.
- [ ] The migrated tree exits zero; the three residual live prose sites use Acceptance Criteria wording.
- [ ] Tests prove a scoped bare SC fails and the same bare token outside scoped paths does not fail.
- [ ] Tests prove both count increase and count decrease fail, and prove duplicate, absent-path, and malformed rows fail.
- [ ] Jira captures, migration/lifecycle probes, reviewer carve-outs, and historical citations remain accepted only at their documented counts.
- [ ] git diff --exit-code a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c -- docs/adr/0021-replication-change-refs.md docs/adr/0022-g2p-in-container.md docs/adr/0023-inbound-github-gerrit-ssh-vote.md .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/dist/editor.js exits 0.
- [ ] A full-repository sweep finds no live deprecated vocabulary outside the count-pinned allowlist and explicit exclusions.
- [ ] make lint, make typecheck, and the full pytest suite pass.
